fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Which service answers the assistant's requests. Each provider keeps its own key and model, so you can switch back and forth.
Create a key at openrouter.ai/keys. Several keys can be entered, separated by commas (up to 30): when one is refused or reaches its limit, the next one is used.
fields.label: OpenRouter API Key

fields.description: Model ID from openrouter.ai/models, e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-5.5
fields.label: OpenRouter Model
Fallback Models
fields.description: Optional, one model ID per line. Used in order when the main model is busy or rate limited, e.g. google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free

fields.label: AgentRouter API Key
fields.description: Several keys can be entered, separated by commas (up to 30): when one is refused or reaches its limit, the next one is used.

fields.label: AgentRouter Model
fields.description: The model name exactly as AgentRouter lists it, e.g. deepseek-v4-flash or claude-opus-4-8

fields.label: Groq API Key
fields.description: From console.groq.com/keys. Several keys can be entered, separated by commas (up to 30): when one is refused or reaches its limit, the next one is used.

fields.label: Groq Model
fields.description: A chat model from console.groq.com/docs/models, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-120b or llama-3.3-70b-versatile

fields.label: Custom Provider API Key
fields.description: Several keys can be entered, separated by commas (up to 30): when one is refused or reaches its limit, the next one is used.

fields.label: Custom Provider Base URL
fields.description: For the OpenAI format, the URL before /chat/completions (e.g. https://example.com/v1); for the Anthropic format, the URL before /v1/messages.

fields.label: API Format
fields.description: OpenAI Chat for models marked chat; Anthropic Messages for models marked claude_native (e.g. Claude on AgentRouter).
Anything the assistant should always know or follow, e.g. tone of voice or company facts
fields.label: Extra Instructions for the Assistant
Speech Recognition
fields.description: Browser: free, built into Chrome and Edge, weaker in Persian. AI Model: the recording is sent to the selected provider (a Whisper model on Groq, or an audio-capable model on OpenRouter); more accurate with names and numbers, and costs like any request.

fields.label: Transcription Model
fields.description: On Groq: whisper-large-v3 (most accurate) or whisper-large-v3-turbo. On OpenRouter: a model that accepts audio input. Empty: whisper-large-v3 on Groq, the main model elsewhere.
